messages:
Anna P.: Quick sync — we need to decide scope for the Dedicated capacity 'elastic guardrails' epic. Customers keep asking for reserved pools that can absorb short spikes without chargeable burst overrides. Thoughts on policy? Goals: predictable SLA, bounded cost for us, developer UX.
Sam R.: I think we should split into two deliverables: 1) a soft cushion (auto-borrow within a pool, free up to X% for short windows) and 2) a hard spill to shared pool with billing. Keeps SLAs but limits exposure.
Michael T.: Customer ask from FinCo: they want 1) guaranteed baseline 2) capacity to absorb 5-min spikes for free. Is a 5-min window feasible, or should we gate by tokens/min + daily cap?
Linh G.: From infra POV, we can implement a per-pool "token bucket" cushion + global spillover throttle. Suggest cushion decays over 24h to avoid carryover gaming. Autoscale hooks must allow immediate preempt if a tenant exceeds cushion.
Anna P.: @Sam @Linh what's the launch criteria? My draft: - policy doc & edge cases defined - perf simulation showing SLOs hold - billing model documented + contract language - integration tests + smoke on Dedicated staging - customer pilot signed. Any additions?
Sam R.: + observability: need per-tenant burst_usage metric, cushion_remaining gauge, and an alert when >50% of cushion consumed in 24h. Also doc fallback behavior (how we degrade: rate-limit, spill, or deny).
Michael T.: Pricing note: if we give a flat 5-min free window it's easy to game. Recommend tokenized approach: tokens = baseline_qps * window; free up to tokens/day. Also tie to reserved SKU so it's predictable.
Linh G.: Implementation knobs we'll need: cushion_pct, cushion_window_sec, daily_burst_cap_tokens, preempt_policy. Also need a ramp window for autoscale to avoid oscillation. Example config snippet:
```
reserved_pool:
  cushion_pct: 12
  cushion_window_sec: 300
  daily_burst_cap_tokens: 25000
  preempt_policy: "evict-best-effort"
  autoscale:
    ramp_seconds: 60
    cooldown_seconds: 300
```
Sam R.: For rollout: feature flag + staged beta, start with 3 pilot customers (high-visibility), monitor cushion usage and billing delta. Also run stress sims with synthetic tenants (Target: simulate 5k tenants, spike patterns).
Anna P.: Action items: - @Sam: draft policy doc + abuse-mitigation examples by Fri - @Linh: perf sim + infra cost estimate by Tue - @Michael: update pricing model and pilot contract language - CS: identify 2 pilot customers and prepare outreach
Sam R.: I'll include a short section on abuse heuristics (token bucket refill limits, sudden repeated spikes, cross-tenant correlation detection).
deploy-bot: deploy pipeline started for dedicated-staging (build 2024.04.17.3) :rocket:
Anna P.: OK, thanks team. Circling back in T-3 days. :thumbsup:
